_comment: Editor layout for the TCSPC DistributedAcceptorModel (FRET: distributed acceptors). The Convolution/Generic/Corrections/Lifetimes panels are copied from lifetime.view.json -- keep them in step, a control added to only one is a parity gap between editors a user reads as the same. There is deliberately NO Anisotropy panel: the polarized channels are built from a lifetime spectrum and this model's decay is not a finite mixture of exponentials, so it fits magic-angle or total decays only. Model-specific: the acceptor density C/C0, the dimensionality, and the R0/tauD0 the density is expressed against.

sections.title: Convolution

sections.label: Type
sections.description: Excitation scheme for the IRF convolution.
descriptions: Periodic excitation: the decay wraps around the repetition period (pulsed laser, tails overlap).
Single excitation, truncated at the histogram window; no wrap-around.
Full (numpy) convolution of one excitation with the model, without wrap-around.

sections.label: Convolve
sections.description: Convolve the model with the IRF. Switch off to compare the bare decay.
Convolution of the model decay with the instrument response function (IRF): IRF curve, excitation mode, convolve switch and IRF time shift.

sections.title: Generic
sections.description: Nuisance terms of the decay: scattered light, constant background (and its curve) and photon counts.

sections.title: Corrections

sections.label: Smoothing
sections.description: Window used to smooth the linearization (DNL) table before it is applied; flat = no smoothing.

items.label: Pile-up
items.description: Correct pile-up distortion of the TCSPC histogram (early photons over-represented at high count rates).

items.label: DNL
items.description: Apply the differential non-linearity (DNL) table to the model to account for uneven channel widths.

items.label: Reverse
items.description: Reverse the time axis of the data (for reverse start-stop acquisition).

sections.description: Switches for the amplitude normalisation of the species.
Detector corrections: DNL linearization table, pile-up and channel smoothing applied to the decay.

sections.title: Lifetimes
sections.description: Fluorescence lifetimes (ns) and amplitudes of the decay components.

sections.title: Distributed acceptors

sections.label: Dimensionality
sections.description: Geometry the acceptors occupy. Sets the stretch exponent d/6 of the decay, so the three cases are distinguishable in the fit.
C/C0 is the number of acceptors within R0 of a donor -- the fitted quantity. R0 and tauD0 are inputs: they define C0, so changing them rescales the density rather than improving the fit.
Transfer efficiency and absolute acceptor density implied by the fitted C/C0 -- computed, not fitted, so neither carries an error bar of its own.
Acceptors distributed in space around the donor (no fixed distance): geometry and acceptor density determining the stretched-exponential decay.
